title: dot11decrypt: Support Fast BSS Transition with RSNXE present
description:
IEEE 802.11-2020 introduced the RSN Extension element (RSNXE). With this
the MIC calculation for Fast BSS Transition was updated. If RSNXE is
present it shall be included in the MIC calculation.

Update the MIC calculation to support decryption of data where the
association includes the RSNXE. Add also a decryption test case.

dot11decrypt: Support Fast BSS Transition with RSNXE present

IEEE 802.11-2020 introduced the RSN Extension element (RSNXE). With this
the MIC calculation for Fast BSS Transition was updated. If RSNXE is
present it shall be included in the MIC calculation.

Update the MIC calculation to support decryption of data where the
association includes the RSNXE. Add also a decryption test case.
